item.title: Small Bathroom Organization: Create More Storage Without Adding Clutter
item.description: Start With the Routine, Not the Containers Small bathrooms often become difficult to use for a simple reason: too many things are competing for too little space. The instinct is usually to buy another organizer. But containers cannot create useful capacity. They can only divide the capacity you already have. Start by watching the room for one normal morning. Notice what you reach for, where you put it, what blocks the sink, which drawer becomes messy, and which products remain untouched for weeks.
